The actor labels (engineer, worker, Honduras, British, company, regulator) are consistent with a single major incident in Baltimore drawing in responders, affected workers and corporate or regulatory parties, though the data does not name the incident.
A second, separate thread appears later in the year. On **18 September**, an IMMIGRANT–UNITED STATES investigation in Washington, DC drew 50 articles. On **21 September**, a CRIMINAL investigation in Maryland drew 80. On **25 October**, a DEPUTY–SETTLEMENT yield in Maryland drew 80 articles at a cooperative +7.0. The IMMIGRANT appeal on 31 March (46 articles) links this thread back to the spring cluster.
Because this is a top-50 sample with no period comparison, it shows where coverage concentrated, not how overall activity changed. The picture is of a Maryland-centered year, with late March as the dominant moment.
